authority: User delegated the choice of release gate: do your best.
scope: Goal 1a only: known-problem recognition and approved stored answers, without generation.

library.approval: Only source-bound references with positive independent verdicts and a correct, executed exact-answer path. Every other entry has an explicit exclusion reason.
library.runtime: Linux bounded sandbox; CPU embeddings only when the complete statement and interface are not an exact match.
library.exclusion_selection: Unqualified candidates remain in retrieval. Never redirect a rejected top candidate to an approved sibling. Protected composition aliases are excluded from the active index.

recognition.selection: All 24 freshly authored/reviewed v2 cases: 12 paraphrases, eight sibling variants, four absent. Original 36 target families excluded before authoring; complete 3288 source catalog retained.
recognition.identity: Independently reviewed target identity, scored separately from query-owned test verdicts.
recognition.correctness: Public checks at request time; private query-owned checks only after the answer returns. Missing evidence is not a pass.
recognition.no_posthoc_changes: Freeze code, data, policy, model, evaluator and environment before opening. Report a failed gate without lowering it; changes motivated by these results require a new independent set.
recognition.limits: Agent-authored/reviewed purposive sample, not human evidence or universal coverage. Report Wilson and family-cluster uncertainty; zero observed wrong answers is not a zero true error rate.
recognition.public_comparison: Explicit public output contracts use exact structure by default; declared numeric-list tolerance, distinct integer sets, distinct integer rows and rational-decimal equality are host-only comparisons. No oracle signature/identity or private check enters recognition. Same public/private rules.

required: visible matched or uncertain candidate identity
separate stored qualification and public-query verdicts
interaction.timing: Report fresh-process startup, first embedding request, warm exact and warm paraphrase paths separately. Count full retrieval, assembly and checking. No isolated-speed claim from shared-host audit timing.

prior_candidate: v1 failed 7/20 known correct; its opened cases are development-only. Gate unchanged.
